description: Prefix trie deletion only unsets terminal flags without pruning dead branch nodes, causing ghost prefix matches in autocomplete.
spec_notes: PrefixTrie.delete must recursively delete empty child nodes when branch has 0 remaining words.

tests.test_trie_pruning.py:
from autocomplete import AutocompleteIndex


def test_insert_and_search():
    idx = AutocompleteIndex()
    idx.add_keyword("apple")
    assert idx.trie.search("apple") is True
    assert idx.trie.search("app") is False
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("app") is True


def test_delete_prunes_isolated_branch_prefix():
    idx = AutocompleteIndex()
    idx.add_keyword("banana")
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("ban") is True
    res = idx.remove_keyword("banana")
    assert res is True
    assert idx.trie.search("banana") is False
    # Since "banana" was the only word with prefix "ban", the branch must be pruned!
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("ban") is False
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("b") is False


def test_delete_shared_prefix_preserves_sibling():
    idx = AutocompleteIndex()
    idx.add_keyword("cat")
    idx.add_keyword("caterpillar")
    idx.remove_keyword("cat")
    assert idx.trie.search("cat") is False
    assert idx.trie.search("caterpillar") is True
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("cat") is True


def test_delete_nonexistent_word():
    idx = AutocompleteIndex()
    idx.add_keyword("dog")
    assert idx.remove_keyword("ghost") is False
    assert idx.remove_keyword("do") is False


def test_multiple_insertions_and_complete_clearing():
    idx = AutocompleteIndex()
    for w in ["he", "she", "his", "hers"]:
        idx.add_keyword(w)
    idx.remove_keyword("he")
    assert idx.trie.search("he") is False
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("he") is True  # "hers" still present
    idx.remove_keyword("hers")
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("he") is False
    assert idx.trie.search("she") is True


def test_empty_trie_search():
    idx = AutocompleteIndex()
    assert idx.suggest_prefix_exists("a") is False
    assert idx.trie.search("a") is False
